# Welcome to the Agent Project

> A practical guide written by practitioners to help get your Agents running securely in production.

- [Welcome to the Agent Project](https://agentproject-ai.github.io/agentproject/readme.md): Welcome to the Agent Project
- [Top 10 AI Agent Security and Governance Controls (Based on OWASP)](https://agentproject-ai.github.io/agentproject/security/readme.md): [AI Agent Sandboxing and Isolation 👍
- [Authors](https://agentproject-ai.github.io/agentproject/authors.md): This is written by a community of practitioners

## Security & Governance

- [AI Agent Sandboxing: Containers vs WASM vs Kernel-Level Isolation](https://agentproject-ai.github.io/agentproject/security/ai_agent_sandboxing_containers_vs_wasm_vs_kernel-level_isolation.md): The shift from "AI that suggests" to "AI that acts" requires moving monitoring from the application layer to the infrastructure layer. If an agent is compromised, its own logs cannot be trusted for governance.
